original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚确认第二例埃博拉病例，为首例死者亲属
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚确认第二例埃博拉病例，患者为39岁男性，是首例死亡病例的密切接触者，此前已在隔离中。首例死者为一名40岁肯尼亚男子，10月5日去世，曾从刚果（金）经乌干达入境肯尼亚而未被检出。肯尼亚卫生部称两例病例相关联，无证据显示疫情在更广泛社区传播。刚果（金）今年已有超过4000人死于埃博拉。

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚确认第二例埃博拉病例，患者为39岁男性，是首例病例的密切亲属
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenya has confirmed a second case of Ebola... The new patient, a 39-year-old man, is a close relative of the first case and was already in quarantine when he fell ill on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: 首例病例为一名40岁肯尼亚男子，10月5日去世，曾从刚果（金）经乌干达入境肯尼亚而未被检出
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The 40-year-old Kenyan man who died on 5 October was diagnosed with Ebola shortly after being admitted to hospital in the capital, Nairobi... He had travelled from DR Congo, through Uganda to Kenya without his illness being detected

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚卫生部称两例病例相关联，无证据显示疫情在更广泛社区传播
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: "Both cases are linked, and there is no evidence of spread in the wider community," the ministry said

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）今年已有超过4000人死于埃博拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: More than 4,000 people have died from Ebola in DR Congo this year, in what is the second most deadly known outbreak to date

key_facts.fact: 首例病例死亡后已确定128名接触者，其中113人已被找到，108人在肯尼亚隔离
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: officials had determined that he had been in contact with 128 people - and since Tuesday 113 of them had been found... Of these, 108 were in quarantine in Kenya and tracing of the remaining 15 continued

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（BBC News Africa）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
首例病例在刚果（金）及机场筛查中多次未被检出，具体原因尚未完全明确
